_comment: ChiSurf updater, native emtk window. Drawn by emtk.view_form over UpdaterModel (gui/model.py): 'updater' is the window (version, status, startup switches, available versions, the three actions, the changelog), 'dialog' the in-app confirm / notice the Qt tool asked with message boxes, 'updating' the progress window the Qt tool showed while it prepared the update. The changelog is Markdown drawn by gui/app.py (a spec cannot draw it).
title: ChiSurf Updater

sections.title: ChiSurf Updater
sections.name: updater
sections.description: Check whether a newer ChiSurf exists, read what changed, and install it.

sections.title: Installed version
sections.name: installed
sections.description: The version of ChiSurf that is running and what the last check found.
The version of ChiSurf installed in this environment.
What the last check found, or what the update is doing.
The package manager (micromamba, mamba or conda) that runs the update, and where it lives.

sections.label: Development
sections.description: ChiSurf currently has no stable release; updates check the development branch. The switch is on and cannot be changed.
The branch the changelog is read from.

sections.title: Startup behavior
sections.name: startup
sections.description: What ChiSurf does about updates when it starts. Both switches are saved at once.

sections.label: Check for updates on startup
sections.description: When enabled, ChiSurf will check for updates during startup.

sections.label: Ignore updates (do not prompt on startup)
sections.description: If enabled, ChiSurf will not prompt about updates during startup.

sections.title: Update
sections.name: update
sections.description: Pick a version and install it.

sections.label: Available versions
sections.description: The versions the update server lists, newest first. Picking one shows the changes up to it. Empty until Check for Updates has found some.
Look for a newer version, install the selected one, or open the package manager.

buttons.label: Check for Updates
buttons.description: Ask the update server which versions exist and whether a newer one than yours is there.

buttons.label: Update Now
buttons.description: Install the selected version. Asks first: the update closes all ChiSurf windows and continues in a separate window. Greyed until a check has found a version.

buttons.label: Package Manager
buttons.description: Open the package manager to manage packages in your environment.

sections.title: Changes since your installed version
sections.description: What changed between the previous and the selected version, from the project's commit history. Fills in after a check.

sections.title: ChiSurf Updater
sections.name: dialog
sections.description: Asks before the update starts and reports what the check found.
What will happen if you confirm.

sections.label: Value
sections.description: The text the question asks for.
Confirm or cancel.

sections.title: Updating
sections.name: updating
sections.description: Shown while the update is prepared.
The latest step of the update: download, command, hand-over to the update window.
The update runs outside ChiSurf; this bar has no end because the length of the install is not known.
